evals.prompt: scan this skill before I install it
evals.expected_output: An offline skill_scanner report for the named skill folder, with CRITICAL findings first and a clear install/don't-install verdict.
expectations: The skill runs scripts/audit.py (or the in-repo trampoline) on the path the user named, not an undeclared extra tree
CRITICAL findings are presented before WARN/INFO, with check id, file:line, and evidence
A CRITICAL finding produces a do-not-install recommendation
The scanner is not executed against untrusted code by running the skill under review

evals.prompt: is this skill safe to install? check for ClawHavoc install lures and credential harvesting
evals.expected_output: A pattern-scan report that names LURE/EXEC/CRED/EXFIL hits when present, plus the AST08 reminder that a clean scan is not a proof of safety.
expectations: Install-lure and curl-to-shell checks are actually run via the bundled scanner
The answer does not claim a clean scan proves the skill is safe
The user is told to read SKILL.md end-to-end after a PASS
No network calls are made and scanned files are not executed

evals.prompt: run the same skill_scanner CI gate locally on agent_skills
evals.expected_output: The canonical scanner run on the skills tree, with an explicit note that this is the same module CI imports.
expectations: The command used is scripts/audit.py or agent_skills/evals/tools/skill_scanner.py
The agent states that CI trampolines into this skill's skill_scanner.py
Exit code / verdict semantics are explained (CRITICAL fails, WARN does not)
